specs_json.compute: 8-core high-performance CPU; optional NVIDIA Jetson Orin (EDU version)

notes: The Unitree G1 is a compact 23-DOF (up to 43 DOF with dexterous hands) humanoid launched in 2024 at a disruptive ~$16k base price. It weighs ~35 kg, folds for transport, and uses a ~9000 mAh (~900 Wh-class) quick-release battery. Aimed at research and development, it features hollow-joint wiring, imitation/reinforcement learning support, and optional Jetson Orin compute.

failure_modes.name: Knee/hip joint motor overheating during dynamic gaits
failure_modes.symptoms: Thermal derating mid-walk, sudden stiffness loss, controller thermal fault codes, robot falls
failure_modes.mitigation: Enforce duty-cycle limits on running/jumping demos; monitor joint temps; add cooling rest intervals

failure_modes.name: Fall-induced structural damage
failure_modes.symptoms: Cracked covers, bent arm links, misaligned joints after balance-loss falls during RL policy testing
failure_modes.mitigation: Use gantry/tether during policy development, enable damping fall-protection mode, inspect after every fall

failure_modes.name: Waist actuator encoder drift
failure_modes.symptoms: Torso orientation offset, degraded balance, calibration errors at boot
failure_modes.mitigation: Re-run factory zero-calibration routine; replace encoder if drift recurs; avoid impact loads on torso

failure_modes.name: Quick-release battery connector wear
failure_modes.symptoms: Intermittent power loss, brownout reboots during high-current motion, connector heat discoloration
failure_modes.mitigation: Inspect/clean contacts, limit swap cycles per connector spec, replace connector assembly proactively

failure_modes.name: Dexterous hand tendon/gear failure
failure_modes.symptoms: Finger fails to close fully, grip force drops, grinding in finger joints
failure_modes.mitigation: Limit grasp force in software, avoid overload objects, keep spare finger modules
